reviews.text: Super Cute with Cats
I take my business partner there when she needs veterinary care and they treat her very, very well.

I would like to thank the entire veterinary team, and especially Sandra, for the care and sensitivity they showed us yesterday. We had to accompany our beloved Gizmo to his death, but thanks to Sandra's empathy, respect and kindness, we felt deeply comforted and accompanied at all times. Thank you very much for taking care of him and us with so much love until the last second.
Emma
Thank you, Marina. We are pleased to know that you were satisfied with the care and treatment you received at Clínica Valencia Veterinaris - Barcelona, ​​in Barcelona.
My dog ​​needed a vaccination and the process was very simple. The vet was very nice to him.

PARKING NOTICE: The clinic no longer has an agreement with the parking garage at 555 Mallorca Street. I drove there because the website states they have free parking, but upon arrival, I found it full. The clinic receptionist explained that they no longer partner with the garage (this is an error that needs to be updated on the website).

PS: The veterinary care and service are excellent; I'm leaving this comment simply as a practical tip so no one else is caught off guard. Best regards.
Hi Aleff, thank you so much for your 5-star rating 😊 We're glad to hear that your experience at our center was positive. …

Hello, they are very kind and affectionate with the animals, they serve quickly and if you ask for an appointment they are punctual, they give good advice, the experience has been very positive, I will return and I recommend it to anyone who needs it. Thank you
Thank you so much, Mercè, for trusting our team at Clínica Valencia Veterinaris - Barcelona. We'll always be here for you whenever you need us.
Thank you Montserrat for trusting our team and valuing our work so highly. Your satisfaction is our greatest reward. Hugs.
Decisive, efficient, very friendly and trustworthy
This is our first time here and I loved it. I highly recommend it. The service, the explanations, the check-up, the advice… everything was fantastic! My dog ​​was very well taken care of.

Scammed!!!
I just took my 17-year-old cat, who has a chronic illness that has worsened in the last 48 hours, to the vet.
The vet sees it as an acute condition and suggests hospitalizing her, stating that without tests she can't give a diagnosis. She mentions that the cat doesn't even have an ocular reflex, but despite this, she insists on hospitalization. The consultation lasts less than 8 minutes. They do a urinalysis, and for this they charge me 91 euros!!! I leave without a diagnosis, without any palliative care, and with a difficult distinction between extortion, clinical care, and empathy.
Disappointing experience!!!!!

In response to your clarification, a veterinarian who made house calls today examined her and agreed with euthanasia as a therapeutic option for an elderly animal with a chronic illness and poor general condition.
It would be important to have a palliative approach beyond purely clinical care, in addition to the profit motive in animal care.

The cat is resting now, and we've found some comfort after our "heartless" visit to your company. Regards.

I was prescribed medication for my cat that I couldn't find in any pharmacy. The pharmacist gave me a solution but told me to consult with the veterinarian first.
When I spoke with my vet, he became defensive and distrustful of me and the written request my pharmacist had kindly given him. He offered me a solution that was 100 times cheaper and legal in that situation.
What did they do? They sold me individual pills... which IS ILLEGAL and I could report to the veterinary association.
We consumers aren't stupid... you should start thinking that we can find a way around this.
And if you don't know whether or not the medications you prescribe are in stock, ask your pharmacy. I won't be back.
Thank you so much, Josue! We're so glad to hear your experience was so positive. We're always here for you!
Thank you so much for your trust in our team at Clínica Valencia Veterinaris. We'll always be here for you whenever you need us.

Thank you for your feedback, Katty.
We'll be here whenever you need us.
Pleasant service

Today we brought in a bird in very bad condition, which we found on the street and they took very good care of us. They took care of the animal showing great sensitivity and transmitting passion for their work. Thank you for helping us❤️‍🩹 …
Pleasant and professional

We took our dog there because his usual vet was closed, and this was the only clinic in the neighborhood that could see us on an emergency Friday at 8 pm. Making time for us with such short notice, almost at closing time, already deserves five stars, but the service we received was, by far, the best we've ever had at a vet visit.

A 10 for attention, a 10 for empathy with the animal, a 10 for information, a 10 for available resources... we arrived almost by chance, but from today on, this is our trusted vet.

Very helpful and knowledgeable staff. I have recently adopted the cat with several pre existing infections. The clinic preformed proper diagnosis and treatment plan that is working very well. There is no issue to receive any answers and tips over the phone in between the vist. I feel like our case is well monitored and attended in a kind and professional manner
Very happy with the treatment we always receive! They have taken care of our two cats since they were little. Very attentive at all times! We recommend this clinic.
Thank you Jose for all these years of trust.

Unfortunately, we do not recommend this clinic. They refused to admit our dog for chemotherapy, even though the specialist himself told us there was no problem with them handling her treatment. We don't understand their lack of professionalism, but it's better that they didn't admit her because we don't know if they would shirk their responsibility in a serious situation requiring specialized and professional care, as they did this time.
They refused to treat our dog because he is too dangerous.
Hi Marisol, thank you so much for your feedback and trust. We're still here for anything you need and will always take care of your colleagues with the utmost commitment.
Excellent service!!! Highly recommended!!!!
We're very happy with the center and especially with our rats' vet. Thank you so much, Edu ❤️❤️
Great professionals and a good team. They are always super friendly.
We chose this clinic for the care of our pets, cats and dog. Excellent professional service. We are very satisfied.
Thank you so much, Laura, for your feedback. We're glad you felt you were in good hands. Hugs

Thank you for your attention, for everything, and for your affection, Miquel and Guillem, who gave our Kira a daughter for us. From the pain and sorrow that my mother, Luna, her sister Kanina, and I feel, a big hug from the heart to all of you. Forever grateful.
Very nice but nothing more

My dog ​​was hit by a car when she ran out in fear because the clinic owner opened the door without waiting for me to tie her up. When I returned with her half-dead, less than five minutes later, the owner was gone. To make matters worse, the vet who saw her failed to notice in the x-rays that her spine was broken, causing me four days of needless suffering. It wasn't until a reputable vet saw her on Monday that I learned I had to have her put down.
Thank you so much, Jorge, for your positive feedback on our veterinary team. We'll always be here for you whenever you need us. Best regards from the entire team at Clínica Valencia Veterinaris

Thank you, Luca, for your positive feedback.
At Clínica Valencia Veterinaris, we'll always be available for anything you need. Best regards.

Terrible service.
Years ago, I had my first dog euthanized by one of the vets, and before sedating him, he didn't even let us say goodbye in private.
Now we have another dog and wanted to give them another chance, but it was a terrible mistake. Every time we go, whether for a consultation or to buy anything, they make us wait an eternity, and then the service we receive is minimal, with responses like, "The instructions say how to use the cream." It's a shame that this is the kind of treatment you get after spending so much money. We'll never be going back.

Over the past month I have had to go to Valencia Veterinarians on several occasions with my "dog", Messi. The result has been that the little dog had to have ligament surgery. Miquel's hands and his experience have worked a miracle and Messi walks perfectly and you can hardly even see the scar. But since not everything in this life is perfect, my dog's little paw got a wound on his leg. This time it was Sandra who applied laser to the wound that looked very bad. The result was also great, the wound is closing up fantastically. Thank you Miquel and thank you Sandra, you are very good. I would like to take this opportunity to send a review to the girls at reception, who are always so kind and caring, you are also great. I encourage you to continue like this, the key to success is good work and good treatment.
Very professional
The service from the entire team was a 10/10, especially Sandra the veterinarian. The treatment was excellent, the cleanliness was a 5/10, and we will definitely be back with our 5 toy poodles.

On Monday, February 24, 2025, at approximately 8:30 PM, I took my Bernese Mountain Dog to the vet because he was limping on his right leg and in pain. When I entered, the three women sitting at the counter, waiting for closing time (9:00 PM), refused to treat my dog ​​at all, claiming they didn't have a veterinarian available. They also couldn't offer me any pain relief, telling me to make an appointment for another day and that it would surely be rude of me to be there. If there's no veterinarian, then no one can diagnose what's wrong, I suppose.

On Tuesday, I took him to my vet. On Wednesday, my dog ​​was on the floor in a lot of pain and quadriplegic. On Thursday, he had a CT scan... and on Friday, he was euthanized. Attention wouldn't have changed my dog's fate, but a little more empathy for owners who are suffering, doing everything possible to alleviate the dog's pain, would have changed my perception of you.

That's all, because I have nothing to thank you for. That's not loving animals, at least not in my experience with you.
Regarding your attempt to save face, I reiterate that the women refused to see my dog ​​at that time, offering to see him another day. My response wasn't to refuse, but to try to ease my dog's pain until the appointment. They told me again that they couldn't prescribe anything.
If you can't provide even the most basic service, or alleviate my dog's pain, why would I come back another day?

Until today the treatment had always been excellent, today needing an emergency visit I was surprised by the lack of empathy of the telephone service person who, instead of trying to find a solution, directly recommended that I look for another clinic. Later he told me that they are now part of a larger veterinary group and had changed the way they serve the public. All I have to do now is collect the dog's history and look for another center.
It is a shame that the trust of a long time ends because of the lack of empathy of a worker or the reorientation of a business.
Thank you Dolors for all these years of trust!!!!
Thank you so much, Facundo, for trusting our team and taking a minute to give us such a positive review. We sincerely appreciate it. Best regards.
Very good veterinarian, they treat animals with love, they provide better service with arranged hours.
Thank you so much Inma for your very positive review. Sending you a hug, and we'll always be here for you whenever you need us.
Thank you, Luis, for your feedback on our veterinary care. We hope to better meet your expectations in the future. Best regards.

My experience and that of my 20-year-old furry boys. I was recommended to you and you have exceeded all expectations, thanks to your professionalism, attention to detail, and love for the animals. Rocco and Leo are always loyal 😻😻. Thank you to the whole team …
Thank you, Diana, for your feedback. Best regards, and we'll be here whenever you need us.

They were our veterinarians.
So grateful for the care they gave our pets Xiky, Noi, and Roma.
Thank you Miguel and everyone!
My usual go away

Excellent service.

They are truly excellent. From the receptionists who are always quick and attentive inquiries to the veterinarians. Guillem always treats my cat with love and great professionalism. Happy and grateful to have my cat taken care of there. 💜 …
Excellent veterinary clinic. Very professional.
